description_raw:
• What’s in the Box

The set includes three long-hanging pod car perfumes in the fragrances Moonlit Musk, Purple Haze, and Black Ice, each meticulously crafted to provide a refined fragrance experience.

  • Perfect for Gifting

This gift set comes in a beautifully designed box with elegant colors and a sophisticated presentation, making it perfect gifting for all special moments and occasions. It is a practical yet stylish gift that your loved one will genuinely enjoy. Every time they drive, the captivating aromas serve as a pleasant reminder of your thoughtful gesture, making this gift truly memorable.

  • Easy to Use

Using your hanging pod is simple and hassle-free. Just unscrew the wooden lid and remove the plastic cap, then screw the lid back on. Turn the pod upside down for 20–25 seconds until it soaks in the fragrance oil, and then hang it on your car’s rear-view mirror using the provided thread.

  • Set of 3 Fragrances

Each fragrance in this gift set is thoughtfully crafted to suit your mood and personal preference. Moonlit Musk brings a warm, comforting aroma, perfect for cozy evening drives or quiet solo journeys. Black Ice delivers a crisp, energizing citrus scent, ideal for refreshing mornings and long open-road trips. Purple Haze offers calming lavender notes to soothe the mind during traffic or hectic commutes.

  • Long-Lasting Freshness

Each hanging pod lasts up to 30 days, meaning this set of three provides a total of 90 days of captivating fragrance.

  • IFRA-Compliant Fragrances


All Aromahpure fragrances are formulated in accordance with IFRA international safety standards, ensuring they are safe and free from harsh chemicals.
